settings_description: Manage your OpenWritingKit preferences and account details.
settings_appearance_description: Customize the look and feel of the application.
settings_editor_font_size_description: Changes will apply to the text editor area.
settings_ai_description: Control your experience with AI-powered writing assistance.
settings_ai_disclaimer: By enabling AI features, you agree that the text you submit for a specific AI function (e.g., "Get Writing Feedback," "Analyze Pacing," "Generate Prompt") will be sent to a third-party AI model for processing to provide that feature. OpenWritingKit does not store this submitted text on its servers or use it for training its own AI models. Your primary document content remains stored locally in your browser. You can disable AI features at any time.
settings_account_disclaimer: Full account management features require backend integration and are not yet implemented.
settings_cloud_description: Securely back up your work to the cloud and sync across devices.
settings_cloud_connect_description: Connect your account to enable cloud backup and synchronization features. This will allow you to access your writing projects from anywhere.
cloud_storage_connect_tooltip: Connect to Google Drive to back up your stories, outlines, and characters, and access them across your devices.
cloud_storage_local_warning: Without connecting, all your data is saved locally in this browser only. This means it can be lost if you clear your browser's data, use a different browser, or switch devices.
